stock.description: Asia Television Holdings Limited operates primarily as an investment holding entity with a wide array of business interests. Its key operations encompass the processing, printing, and sale of finished fabrics across mainland China, Hong Kong, and Malaysia. In addition to its textile business, the company's portfolio includes trading in fabrics and apparel, offering financial services like money lending and margin finance, and active involvement in securities investment and brokerage. It also participates in the media, culture, and entertainment industries and manages property and intellectual property holdings. The company further provides subcontracting and management services, alongside securities underwriting and placement services. Founded in 2003, the firm, headquartered in Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong, was formerly known as Co-Prosperity Holdings Limited and adopted its current name in April 2018.
